name: Fire Bolt

descriptionTemplate: {c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} launches an additional parallel bolt, dealing {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE}{/c} Fire damage.

name: Shiver
description:
Fire Bolt becomes a Frost Skill, dealing {payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE} Cold damage and {dot:UPGRADEC_FROSTBITE} Frostbite damage over [SF_0] seconds.

Fire Bolt pierces [SF_27] time and makes enemies Vulnerable for {SF_24} seconds.

{c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE}{/c} Cold damage and {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEC_FROSTBITE}{/c} Frostbite damage over {c_number}[SF_0]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Fireball{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill that deals Cold damage.

description:
Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Charges: [SF_9 + 1]
Charge Cooldown: {Recharge Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat_Effect_Chance_Script_Formula_Override:17}|%|]
Engulf yourself in flames for [{buffduration:FLAMESHIELD_BUFF}|1|] |4second:seconds;, becoming Immune and dealing {dot:TOOLTIP_BURNING_DAMAGE} Burning damage over [{buffDuration:BURNING_DAMAGE}] seconds to surrounding enemies.

Flame Shield becomes a Shock Skill, deals Sparking damage, and triggers its Cooldown on Cast.

Instead of becoming Immune you embody lightning, generating {SF_33} Crackling Energy per second and gaining [SF_31 * 100|x%|] Movement Speed and [SF_32 * 100|1%|] Dodge.
